# sdrtrunk-vce 0.6.2 Alpha 6

Alpha 6 adds safer legacy-playlist importing, easier DMR channel-map editing, stronger NXDN metadata and validation,
and support for P25 ISSI foreign-system band plans.

This is still alpha software. Stop sdrtrunk-vce and back up its complete portable `data` folder before replacing an
earlier build.

## Added

- File > Import Legacy Playlist XML can preview and merge aliases, channels, channel maps, and streams from an older
  SDRTrunk XML playlist into the current portable database.
- Import conflicts can be skipped, kept as renamed copies, or used to replace matching items. References to renamed
  alias lists, streams, and channel maps follow the imported items.
- The importer creates a timestamped SQLite safety backup before it applies changes and attempts to restore that backup
  if the import fails.
- The DMR editor accepts complete channel maps pasted from a spreadsheet. Tabs, commas, semicolons, or whitespace are
  accepted; frequencies may use MHz or Hz, and the uplink column is optional.
- P25 ISSI foreign systems retain separate band plans, so matching band IDs from different systems do not overwrite one
  another.
- Startup and Help > Check for Updates can report a newer published build. The application opens the release page but
  does not download or install updates.

## Changed

- NXDN saved-call metadata retains additional call, codec, identifier, and frame context. Decoder validation now covers
  more published protocol vectors and Type-D messages.
- Cloning a DMR channel preserves its decoder options and creates an independent copy of every channel-map row.
- Pasted DMR maps are sorted and validated before replacement. Duplicate logical channel numbers, invalid frequencies,
  missing columns, and nonnumeric values are rejected without partially changing the map.
- Repeated ISSI observations update bounded current and summary records instead of accumulating duplicate band
  definitions.
- The status footer is enabled once after upgrading so update availability is visible. Turning it off afterward remains
  respected.

## Fixed

- Events and Messages tables report the correct removed row when their configured history limit is exceeded, including
  while a table sorter is active.
- Legacy DMR XML imports retain large Tier III frequency maps, decoder options, traffic-channel limits, and optional
  uplink frequencies.
- Matching P25 band IDs advertised by different foreign systems no longer collide with each other or with the monitored
  home system.

## Before You Download

- Alpha 6 advances the P25 activity schema from version 19 to version 20. A graphical startup offers **Upgrade and
  Start**, creates a standalone safety backup, runs the bundled one-off migration helper against a staged copy, checks
  integrity and foreign keys, and installs the result only after validation succeeds.
- A headless receiver with an existing version 19 database must be started once with `--upgrade-current`. To import a
  previous portable installation into a new data folder, use `--upgrade-data <previous-app-or-data-folder>`.
- Back up the complete portable `data` folder before upgrading. Returning to Alpha 5 requires restoring both the older
  application and its matching pre-migration database.
- Replace the application files instead of combining two releases, and keep the portable data directory in its existing
  location.
- The legacy-playlist importer creates its own pre-import database backup, but that does not replace the complete
  data-folder backup required before an application upgrade.
- After upgrading, confirm that expected tuners and channels start, then verify audio, recording, streaming, statistics,
  and browser access.

## Downloads

Use the package that matches your operating system and processor. Java 25 is included. JMBE remains a separate setup
under Preferences > Decoder > JMBE Audio Library. Verify the downloaded ZIP with `SHA256SUMS.txt` before installing.
